# NorthPeak Technologies

> Engineering team behind 50+ successful product launches. MVP development, AI solutions, web & mobile apps — shipped in weeks, not months.

NorthPeak Technologies is a technology and product consultancy that helps startups and growing businesses turn ideas into production-ready software. We specialise in modern web development, AI-powered solutions, and cloud infrastructure — working as an embedded partner, not just a vendor.

## Services

- MVP Development: Go from idea to live product in 4 weeks with clean, scalable architecture.
- AI Integration: LLM-powered features, intelligent agents, and adaptive learning platforms.
- Web & Mobile Apps: Full-stack React, Next.js, and React Native applications.
- Project Rescue: Take over stalled or broken projects and get them shipping again.
- Cloud Infrastructure: AWS architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and scalable backend systems.
- Real-Time Systems: WebSocket-based features, live dashboards, and concurrent user systems.

## Team

- Mohsin Iqbal, Software Engineer & Co-Founder: 5+ years architecting production-grade systems. Specialises in full-stack development, AI integration, real-time systems, and data pipelines.
- Aamir Farooq, Software Engineer & Co-Founder: 5+ years building full-stack production systems and AI-powered products. Specialises in end-to-end application architecture, LLM integrations, and scalable cloud infrastructure.
